9c9a2b508b.q: What does the dash on an obituary card represent according to Jessie's Place Podcast?
9c9a2b508b.a: The dash is the small line between your birth date and death date on an obituary card. It represents everything that happens in your life: your love, mistakes, dreams, children, friendships, heartbreak, accomplishments, failures, the people you meet, the people you lose, the risks you take, and the things you build. Everything happens inside that tiny dash.

66c2a8d49e.q: Why do people wait to live their lives instead of appreciating the present moment?
66c2a8d49e.a: Most people spend their lives waiting for the next accomplishment, promotion, relationship, house, or money before they allow themselves to be happy. They think 'I'll be happy when I lose weight' or 'I'll be happy when I make more money' or 'I'll be happy when I get that house', but as soon as you get there, you create another destination. There is no 'there'—there is now.

da37e8a7f9.q: What does leadership mean if you don't have a title or position yet?
da37e8a7f9.a: Leadership is simply being willing to go first, even when you don't know exactly how it will work out. It could be starting a business, leaving a relationship, going back to school, picking up a microphone to tell your story, or pursuing a dream you've been talking yourself out of for years. You don't need a title, followers, money, experience, credentials, or confidence—you just need to be willing to try.
